name: Vampire Hunter
source:
After finishing High School while working a part-time job to make money. You and girlfriend are trying to figure out what to do with your life together. Sadly you don't get to live happily ever after with your girlfriend, shortly after she leaves after a long time she gets chased down and attacked by a vampire. You now have dedicated a lot of time & energy trying to find the one who killed your high school sweat heart.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
高中毕业后，一边做兼职一边赚钱。你和女朋友正在考虑如何度过共同的生活。可悲的是，你不能和你的女朋友幸福地生活在一起，在她离开很长时间后不久，她就被吸血鬼追赶和袭击。你现在投入了大量的时间和精力试图找到那个杀死你高中汗心的人。

[来自Itch.io]
